name: Akbar Abdullaev
event: UFC Fight Night: Adesanya vs. Magomedov
summary: An unbeaten Kyrgyz lightweight (14-0, age 29), formerly of ONE Championship, who knocked out Ednilson Barros Santos in 19 seconds on the Contender Series in September; Dana White called him one of the greatest talents in the show's history. This is his UFC debut.

how_they_fight.Striking: A knockout puncher: thirteen of 14 wins by knockout in our data, nine in R1.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Has finished in R3 twice and in R5 once (ONE), so he can go long.

patterns: One-punch power; most finishes in R1
concerns: Has not faced a fighter of Santos's level
keys_to_beat: Wrestle him and take him late

news.text: UFC debut booked against Mairon Santos (first reported by Ag.Fight).
